briefs.claim_en: 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, leading to an increase in cases in areas where 5G was installed.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including the United Nations International Telecommunication Union (ITU) on April 22, 2020, and the UK government on May 6, 2020, state there is no scientific basis or credible evidence linking 5G technology to the spread of coronavirus. Fact-checking organizations like AP News, AFP Fact Check, and Full Fact have rated claims of a connection between 5G and COVID-19 as false, with AFP Fact Check doing so as early as April 7, 2020. The World Health Organization (WHO) and other experts confirm that viruses cannot travel via radio waves or mobile networks, and that electromagnetic fields cannot transfer viruses or compromise the immune system. The Washington Post reported on May 13, 2020, that the DHS was advising telecom firms on preventing attacks on 5G towers due to these conspiracy theories.
